Potato___Early_blight.Environment: Warm temperatures (24–29°C), high humidity and frequent rainfall favor disease development.
Potato___Early_blight.Spread: Spores spread through wind, rain splash, contaminated soil, infected plant debris and seed tubers.
Potato___Early_blight.Description: Early Blight is one of the most common fungal diseases of potato. It usually begins on older leaves and gradually spreads upward, reducing photosynthesis and tuber yield.

Age_Cycle.Early: Small dark brown spots appear on older leaves.
Age_Cycle.Moderate: Lesions enlarge with concentric rings and yellow halos.
Age_Cycle.Severe: Leaves dry and die, stems weaken and tuber quality decreases.
Age_Cycle.Estimated: Symptoms generally develop within 7–14 days after infection.

Recommended_Actions: Apply preventive fungicides during humid weather.
Destroy infected plant residue after harvest.

Potato___Late_blight.Environment: Cool temperatures (10–22°C), prolonged rainfall and humidity above 90%.
Potato___Late_blight.Spread: Wind-borne spores, rain splash, infected seed tubers and contaminated equipment.
Potato___Late_blight.Description: Late Blight is one of the most destructive potato diseases. Under favorable weather conditions it can spread rapidly and destroy an entire crop within days.

Age_Cycle.Early: Water-soaked pale green lesions appear on leaves.
Age_Cycle.Moderate: Brown lesions enlarge rapidly and white fungal growth appears underneath leaves.
Age_Cycle.Severe: Leaves collapse, stems rot and tubers develop brown internal rot.
Age_Cycle.Estimated: Disease may spread across a field within 3–7 days during favorable weather.

Recommended_Actions: Inspect fields daily during cool wet weather.

Potato___healthy.Environment: Well-drained fertile soil, balanced nutrition, proper irrigation and adequate sunlight.
Potato___healthy.Description: The uploaded potato leaf shows no visible symptoms of disease or pest infestation. The plant appears healthy.

Age_Cycle.Estimated: Continuous healthy growth under proper crop management.

Organic_Treatment: Apply balanced organic fertilizers when needed.
Prevention: Keep the field free of weeds.
Recommended_Actions: Monitor plants weekly for early disease symptoms.
